The son of co-founder İzzet Özilhan, he helped expand the family's beer and soft-drinks businesses into international markets alongside wider retail and automotive interests. He served as chief executive for more than three decades and as chairman until 2025.

long_biography.plain_text:
At school, Tuncay Özilhan played in an amateur basketball team. He later helped establish Efes Pilsen Sports Club in 1976, recruiting his school friend Pano Natof after the group acquired Kadıköy Spor. As club president, he backed professional managers and the development of young players, maintaining support through periods of economic difficulty.

Pens have been another longstanding interest. Özilhan has sought additions to his collection in shops during overseas trips and carried favourite examples in a special case. His purchases have included a numbered Montegrappa pen made to commemorate Mustafa Kemal Atatürk.
